subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectServices
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous per-object runtime behaviors across rendering (mesh vertex lighting, MMX color blend, billboard reflection), resource loading (bitmap and D3D resource loads), network sessions (socket teardown, query-id send, chunked send, connection handling), shadow-cascade view initialization, UI/tree state nodes, audio access, and allocation helpers.

summary: This scope aggregates 24 generic runtime-object behaviors. The strongest evidence clusters are: (1) a mesh rendering helper set (ProcessMeshVerticesWithLighting, VertexColorBlendMMX, BillboardDirectionCompute) sharing a render-descriptor `this` layout and the device-wrapper vtable at dword_8B8F24; (2) a bitmap/resource loading pair (BitmapFileLoad, RenderingBitmapFileLoad) that share the resource-table pattern `*(this+0x128) << 8 + this+0x124` plus a guarded D3D resource loader (loadRenderingResources) driving a loader vtable at this+0x1100; (3) a socket/network cluster (SocketCloseAndCleanup, AppendQueryIdAndSend, SendBufferChunkedOnBackslash, NetworkCleanup, NetworkConnection) handling teardown, query-id wire tokens and connection management; (4) two complementary flag operators on a UI widget state word (Bit1FlagSet / StateFlagBitClear); (5) a recursive shadow-cascade view initializer with its own DERIVED owner; and (6) small dispatcher/allocator helpers (AudioValueSetterCall, ConditionalNetworkUtility, TwoStepDispatch, AudioNoteParamIndexSearchLoop, QueryWithContextCleanup, SetRunningFlagIfInitialized, StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType, AudioMixerSampleGetWithFallback, StringMallocCopy). Class boundaries below are GUESS proposals; several functions keep UNKNOWN owners in the packet and could belong to other objects. Field identities are per base+offset and were not merged across bases without packet support.

function_roles.role: Per-triangle mesh vertex lighting, normal/specular packing and per-vertex color write into the render output vertex buffer.
Per-vertex MMX color blend between source and destination vertex buffers.
Per-vertex billboard reflection texcoord computation via device vtable transforms.
Bitmap resource load from archive with raw or processed read and resource-manager registration.
Rendering-composition bitmap load variant gated by the initialization global dword_8B8E28.
Guarded load of three D3D rendering resources plus a finalizer call through the loader vtable at this+0x1100.
Recursive shadow-map cascade view creation, naming, projection setup and sibling/child recursion.
Raise state flag bit 1 at this+0x24.
Clear state flag bit 1 at this+0x24.
Recursive tree node traversal visiting guarded children then processing the current node.
Socket handle teardown, struct release and WSACleanup.
Append a \queryid\ token to the send buffer and transmit it via sendto.
Recursive backslash-safe chunked socket send under a 0x546-byte buffer limit.
Network session teardown of the batch sub-object, audio array, sub-object and the session itself.
Store a value at the object base and dispatch through the per-object callable, returning its result.
Null-guarded network struct allocation and dispatch through a stored callback.
Two-step dispatch deriving an index then searching the note-param space.
Linear search for an element index matching a short field and a derived comparison value.
Network session connection handling: entry lookup/tag/removal, socket array creation, state signal and polling.
Query helper computing a value from per-query context and dispatching the result through a stored callable.
Raise the running flag at this+0x74 when the this+0x00 pointer is initialized.
Allocate and initialize a 20-byte struct with a type-switched typed array.
Resolve an audio mixer sample through double-call indirection with a caller-supplied fallback.
Allocate and copy a C string buffer, returning the owned copy.

classes.name: MeshRenderProcessor
classes.responsibility: Mesh vertex processing and color generation for rendering: per-triangle lighting, per-vertex MMX color blend and billboard reflection texcoord computation, driven through the device-wrapper vtable at dword_8B8F24.

classes.name: RenderingResourceLoader
classes.responsibility: Loads bitmap and D3D rendering resources: filename validation, resource-table entry resolution through this+0x128/this+0x124, buffer allocation, raw/processed archive read, and registration into the resource manager global dword_8B78A0 or through the loader vtable at this+0x1100.

classes.name: ShadowCascadeViewInitializer
classes.responsibility: Recursively constructs and configures one shadow-map cascade view for directional-light rendering: detects existing cascades through the this+0x18 -> +0x138 -> +0x40 pointer chain, allocates and names a 444-byte view object, sets near/far projection and rotation from the light, allocates a secondary object and a 1024-int array, then recurses into sibling/child views.

classes.name: UIWidgetStateNode
classes.responsibility: Holds a state dword at this+0x24 whose bit 1 is raised or lowered by the paired set/clear helpers invoked while the UI widget recursive state update descends the widget tree.

classes.name: SceneGraphTreeNode
classes.responsibility: Recursive tree node traversal: a skip flag at this+0x3C gates the whole walk, a child pointer at this+0x44 is always recursed when non-null, and a second pointer at this+0x4C is recursed only when both this+0x40 and this+0x4C are non-null, after which the current node is processed.

classes.name: NetworkSocketSession
classes.responsibility: Socket session lifecycle and wire transmission: closes and resets the primary/secondary socket handles, frees the session struct unless it is the default singleton, appends \queryid\ tokens and sends buffers over UDP, recursively chunk-sends long strings under a 0x546-byte limit, and tears down sub-objects and arrays.

classes.name: NetworkConnectionManager
classes.responsibility: Network session connection handling: validates the server address, resolves a server entry by ID, tags and removes entries, creates the socket array, signals connection state through the state dispatcher and enters the polling loop.

classes.name: StateValueDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Stores an incoming value at the object base and dispatches through a per-object callable (function pointer at byte offset 120), passing the captured previous value at byte offset 124 as an argument, and propagates the callable's result.

classes.name: ParamIndexSearch
classes.responsibility: Parameter-index lookup: TwoStepDispatch derives an index/limit from the object field at this+0x04 and AudioNoteParamIndexSearchLoop linearly searches an element array for an index whose short field and derived value both match.

classes.name: NetworkStructAllocator
classes.responsibility: Allocates and dispatches network structs: ConditionalNetworkUtility null-guards then allocates a struct by the type selector at this+0x94 and dispatches through the callback at this+0x04; StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType builds the 20-byte struct header and a type-switched typed array.

classes.name: ContextQueryDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Query helper: computes a value via sub_564110 using the per-query context at this+0x94, then routes the result through the invocable target held at this+0x04 via the single-function-call wrapper.

classes.name: RunningStateController
classes.responsibility: Raises an activity flag at this+0x74 when the sub-object pointer at this+0x00 is non-null, signaling that the network update loop is running.

classes.name: AudioMixer
classes.responsibility: Resolves an audio-mixer sample object through a double-call indirection and returns the sample stored at element 1 of the resolved object, falling back to a caller-supplied default when the indirection yields null.

classes.name: StringBufferAllocator
classes.responsibility: Allocate-and-copy helper for C strings: allocates strlen+1 bytes and copies the source, returning the owned buffer or NULL on null input or allocation failure.

transitions.via: display-mode query path incrementing a1[38] when array state is 1 or 2

interfaces.name: DeviceTransformService
interfaces.purpose: Vtable-based D3D device wrapper at dword_8B8F24 providing transform/light-vector and per-vertex world-position services; the context pointer dword_8B8F28 accompanies it. Mesh lighting and billboard reflection consume vtable slots +0/+4 (vertex transforms) and +20/+24 (light/transform vectors).

interfaces.name: ResourceLoaderVTable
interfaces.purpose: Loader object at this+0x1100 exposing vtable method slots at +0xC8 (+300, resource load taking an identifier pair, output handle and 16-byte buffer) and +0x12C (+200, finalize call with literal arguments).

interfaces.name: SingleFunctionCallDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Stored function pointer at object+0x04 invoked through SingleFunctionCallWrapper_48c0 with a by-address output slot; used by network struct dispatch, the query helper and the connection handler.

interfaces.name: ResourceManagerContract
interfaces.purpose: Global resource manager at dword_8B78A0 receiving loaded bitmap data through ResourceLoadWithOutput (0x00540050) and RenderingCompositionSetup (0x0053FED0), returning output pointers through caller-supplied slots.

compatibility_contracts.name: MeshVertexOutputLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The render output vertex buffer uses a 64-byte stride with a packed color dword at +24, a specular color dword at +28 and reflection texcoord floats at +40/+44; the source vertex buffer uses a 48-byte stride with its color at +24. A nonzero flag at this+0x13C selects the 64-byte format.

compatibility_contracts.name: MMXColorBlendInvariant
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-lane byte color blend unpacks source and destination bytes to words with the zero word-mask qword_8B6C20, adds the blend offset qword_8B8E40, multiplies, shifts right by 8, packs back to bytes, and clears MMX state afterwards.

compatibility_contracts.name: BitmapResourceTableEntryLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Resource-table entries expose a data size at entry+8, a second size at entry+12, a flag byte whose bit 0x10 selects a processed (decompressed/transformed) read path, and a filename at entry+20; raw reads must return the exact byte count.

compatibility_contracts.name: SocketTeardownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The primary socket handle is closed only when it differs from -1 and the active flag at +0xE4 is non-zero; the secondary handle only when it differs from both -1 and the primary; both are reset to -1, the field at +0xD8 is zeroed, and the struct is freed unless it is the default singleton at unk_5E4CF8.

compatibility_contracts.name: QueryIdWireToken
compatibility_contracts.description: A non-empty send buffer is extended with a \queryid\%d.%d token (built from the stored base id and the incremented per-socket counter), transmitted via sendto over a 16-byte sockaddr, and cleared afterwards.

compatibility_contracts.name: ChunkedSendBufferLimit
compatibility_contracts.description: Outbound socket sends are constrained to a 0x546-byte buffer; long tails are split at backslash positions chosen so that even consecutive backslash runs (escaped pairs) are not cut apart.

compatibility_contracts.name: ShadowViewObjectLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A 444-byte shadow view object is constructed, named with the 'SHADOWVIEW%.3d' format, carries a validity flag at +0x230, and has its projection derived from the light near plane and dword_8B8DF4.

compatibility_contracts.name: NetworkEntryTagLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Resolved server entries are tagged by storing a5 at +8 and the literal 9999 into the +6 word, then removed from the element array via ArrayElementRemovalWithShift with the live count decremented.

unresolved: Mesh render descriptor offsets this+0x54, this+0x70, this+0xB8 and this+0x150 are listed as accessed in the fact tables but do not appear in the decompiled bodies; their roles remain unknown.

Float globals dbl_59E430, flt_59E43C, flt_59E450 and flt_59FEC8 are listed as read but absent from the visible bodies; they are likely constants folded into the numeric code and their roles are unestablished.

The deterministic guard on mesh this+0xA0 (value less than 0) is interpreted as the selector between the blended per-vertex lighting path and the simple flat pack; that interpretation is derived from skeleton analysis, not proven.

The two device-wrapper vtable method groups (vtable+0/+4 versus vtable+20/+24) and the exact meaning of the output-buffer +24/+28/+40/+44 slot layout are inferred from use, not from a known struct contract.

Billboard function fields this[11] (0x2C) and this[84] (0x150) are listed as read but do not appear in the raw body; flt_59E43C and flt_59E450 are likewise absent and likely consumed inside the D3D transforms.
The shadow packet global dbl_5B8998 is not referenced by the raw body of 0x00560C10; the body uses flt_5DD848, aShadowview3d and dword_8B8DF4 only.
Semantics of the two word constants qword_8B6C20 and qword_8B8E40 (unpack mask versus fixed-point blend offset) are interpreted from the MMX idiom, not from a labeled source.
The 0x546 byte limit and the 1350-character scan window in the chunked send are structural wire limits whose packet-level meaning (likely a wire-packet size cap) is not established.
The resource-table entry layout (flag bit 0x10 semantics, filename at entry+20) and sub_59B260 post-processing semantics are not further evidenced by this packet.
The WSACleanup thunk is invoked at return in SocketCloseAndCleanup and NetworkCleanup but has no callee evidence entry, so its address is not recorded.
AudioValueSetterCall's fixed indirect-call arguments (1, 0, 0) and the role of the byte-offset-124 previous value are not established; its dispatcher object is unknown.
The literal 9999 stored into the +6 word of network entries and the value 3 passed to AudioValueSetterCall by NetworkConnection have unestablished semantics.

NetworkConnection's a1 indices (0, 1, 2, 28, 29, 38) and sub-fields (+8, +6, +28*v12+4) are read directly from the decompiled body with no packet field evidence; a1[38] (the display-mode query counter) has no allowed field evidence ref and is therefore not expressed as a class field; the class merge of its this+0x74 running flag with RunningStateController's is a GUESS.

The element array element type, the semantics of sub_563E70, and the interpolation semantics of LinearInterpolation (0x005648B0) are not defined in the packet; the equality match criteria cannot be interpreted beyond the equality test.
StructAllocInitWithSwitchBasedType stores the constant 9999 at offset +6 and switches element count by type selector (0-3 gives 2, default gives 4); the type selector meaning is undocumented.
All class boundaries in this proposal are GUESS: the packet assigns DERIVED owners only to ShadowCascadeViewInitializer and AudioMixer and UNKNOWN to every other function.

StateValueDispatcher byte offsets 120/124 and StringMallocCopy/AudioMixer internals are described in packet text but carry no allowed field evidence refs, so no class field entries were made for them.
